title: The one hint that tells you to get the priest's barrow-blessing before promising the reeve to seal the barrow ('Ask his blessing before promising the reeve — both wishes hold. Promise first, and he wants his own way past it') is ordinary dialogue at the inn that can easily be heard after the fact, as it was for me — the promise-to-the-reeve choice itself carries no warning that it forecloses the priest's path.
where: Last Light Inn (innkeep, 'the reeve and the priest') / Gray Chapel (gray priest, 'a blessing for the barrow')
